fonts.display: 'Arial', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Neue Machina', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Buttercream
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, light text on dark — the warm cream ground that unifies the entire site

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary text, hairlines, card borders, outlined button borders, link strokes — the only structural non-cream color in the neutral stack

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Near-black surface for dark cards, filled button background, nav strip — slightly softer than pure ink for large fills

palette.name: Driftwood
palette.role: Muted hairline borders on cards and lists, warm gray that sits between buttercream and ink without breaking the warmth

palette.name: Stone
palette.role: Secondary card text and tertiary borders — the warm mid-gray for de-emphasized copy

palette.name: Amber Pulse
palette.role: First sunset band (Font Generator) — warm yellow stripe signaling the start of the category stack

palette.name: Ember Glow
palette.role: Second sunset band (Cool Symbols) — saturated orange that pushes the stack hotter

palette.name: Signal Red
palette.role: Third sunset band (Name Generator) — true red midway through the gradient

palette.name: Merlot Depth
palette.role: Fourth sunset band (Emoticons) — deep crimson cooling the stack

palette.name: Plum Shadow
palette.role: Fifth sunset band (PFP Maker) — the darkest plum, the bottom of the heat-map
